::: {.callout-tip}
### Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, learners will be able to:

- understand what Explainable AI (xAI) is, explain the concept, and recognize why it is particularly important in life sciences
- identify relevant xAI techniques for selected real-world scenarios (e.g., lab practice, clinical medicine, pharmacy)
:::
